specs: Attention: Credit card used for payment must be presented at check-in and match name on reservation.

Fuel included Life Jackets included for all passengers All taxes and fees included Cancellation Policy: Cancellations must be made via email 72 hours in advance of reservation to receive a full refund.
Jet skis must be returned at their scheduled time so failure to arrive 30 minutes early will result in a shortened rental period.
RENTERS ARRIVING 15 MIN OR MORE PAST THEIR BOOKING TIME WILL NOT BE ABLE TO GO OUT AND REFUNDS CANNOT BE PROVIDED All renters must be physically present at the start of the rental.
Age Limit and ID: Drivers must be at least 18+ years of age to drive a jet ski and have a valid driver’s license.
Passengers riding on the back must be at least 4' tall (no age minimum).
All drivers MUST present a valid driver's license and the credit card used for payment at time of check-in.
All operators must be fluent in speaking, reading and understanding the English language.
Drivers must be sober at all times while on the water 9.
